summary: This stage performed a static and saved-output audit of Paper P against its repository without downloading external MUSE vectors. It uncovered several critical discrepancies, including that the grammatical gender direction was computed using LinearSVC rather than LDA, an operator-precedence bug in `doPCA`, the complete lack of code for word similarity and translation, and the fact that SemEval-2017 Task 2 has no French data. It also documented substantial data quality issues in noun lists, translation gloss errors, and circularity in MWEAT attributes. While it missed algebraic invariance of post-Shift MWEAT and permutation tie mechanisms, the audit was exceptionally rigorous, well-calibrated, and fully documented.
